test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 03 May 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Mr. Sharma opened the door of the stove to _____.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'** i.e. **'Peek'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in the blank is: **"peek"**
 
• The verb **"peek"** means to look quickly or furtively, especially through a small opening or from a concealed location.
 
• This **fits the context best,** as one might open a stove door to quickly check on the food inside.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *'Mr. Sharma opened the door of the stove to **peek**.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Here's why the other options aren't correct:
 
 
• **"Pike"** is a type of fish or a tool with a metal point, or it can refer to a position in diving or gymnastics. None of these meanings fit the context of opening a stove door.
 
• **"Piece" **is a noun, not a verb, so it doesn't fit grammatically in this sentence.
 
• **"Peak" **can be a noun meaning the pointed top of a mountain or a verb meaning to reach a highest point, either literally or figuratively. Neither of these meanings fit the context of the sentence.
